steps.label: Fill mug with skimmed milk
steps.recipe_text: Fill-Fill a microwave-safe mug with skimmed milk

steps.label: Microwave mug contents
steps.recipe_text: Microwave-Microwave the contents of the mug for 1 minute

steps.label: Add sugar to mug
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 1 teaspoon of white sugar to the mug

steps.label: Add chocolate to mug
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 2 pieces of chocolate to the mug

steps.label: Add cinnamon to mug
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 1/5 teaspoon cinnamon to the mug

steps.label: Mix mug contents
steps.recipe_text: Mix-Mix the contents of the mug

steps.label: Heat mug contents and serve
steps.recipe_text: Heat-Heat the contents of the mug for 1 minute and serve
